events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries increasing. The US has shown military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is a concern. The war has become a complex issue, involving military, economy, and geopolitics.
events.reasoning: The escalating war in Iran is likely to increase gold prices due to safe-haven demand. Emerging markets are likely to be negatively affected by the geopolitical instability.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US-Iran relations and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when gold prices stabilize or emerging markets show signs of recovery

events.title: Nvidia Earnings Report

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is likely to keep interest rates steady due to the oil shock, but may hike rates in the future if inflation stays elevated.
